title: Reference the character’s skin by adding a skin image as an element reference…
content: Reference the character’s skin by adding a skin image as an element reference in Seedance to influence/adjust skin appearance.
tips: Reference the character’s skin by adding a skin image as an element reference in Seedance to influence/adjust skin appearance.
